items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The greatest concert pianist, Robert Harris - I don't think you met him but he's usually at my parties - he teaches over at Juilliard and if you ever want to know the piano and learn how to play the piano, get to him. I hurt my fingers and I went to him and he gave me exercises to do

ctx.x: Would you have liked to have played classical music?

No, I don't think so. A concert pianist told me - Robert Harris been trying to get me to do that. He heard me when I was really in good form at the Hickory House. You know, the same reason I won't play commercial rock. Commercial rock makes you corny. Jazz pushes off, you know, like an eighth note tied/over to a quarter in the next bar. It pushes off, it goes easy, like this, but rock, 1-2-3-4-bop, like that... I don't want to get stiff like that. I had a drummer and a bass player to kind of stiffen me out a…
